extension.news: [B]3.0.0[/B] - Complete rework for the rebuilt star.gr, whose starx.gr pages, ajax endpoints and old video section no longer exist - Live, TV shows, video hubs, news and StarX rebuilt on the new layouts - Full 37k video catalogue from the video sitemaps, newest first with page navigation - Programme guide (/tv/programma/) as a custom WindowXML dialog with day strip, schedule rows and now-airing badge - Stream resolution delegated to ResolveURL / the PluginsGR StarGR resolver (live m3u8, kwik m3u8, episode contentUrl, YouTube embeds via YouTubeGR) - Non-blocking page indicator overlay with configurable screen position and margins - Modernized stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache
